page.overview:
Who is Beat?

In World Mission, it is revealed that Beat is a descendant of Goku.

Beat's appearance is similar to that of Goku in Dragon Ball GT, but he is a little taller and has a different hairstyle, resembling Goku's hair in his Super Saiyan form leaning to the side. He has worn numerous outfits over the years.

His first outfit as the Saiyan Hero is similar to Goten's in Dragon Ball Z, which featured a bright red dobok with matching pants, a yellow long sleeved t-shirt, a teal obi knot-tied in the middle of his waist, yellow leg wraps, and black shoes with white accents.

His second Class-up outfit is seen in the ninth trailer. It is similar to his original outfit, but with several notable changes. The neckline on his gi is now much deeper and his undershirt becomes black. In addition he gains a yellow ring scarf with an attached cape, a short teal waist cloak, bicep-length black gloves with white cuffs, and black boots with a white cuff, toe cap, and sole.
